response: ["Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ. (PMID 30392755)", "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness. (PMID 30392755)", "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis. (PMID 39709737)", "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia. (PMID 39709737)", "The recommendation for primary excision has a consensus rate of 100% (21/21). (PMID 39709737)"]
